//Google: Sign in with Google. ClientIds are the OAuth client ids a Google ID token may be minted for (the Web application client id, which the website and the Android app both request tokens for; the project's Android client ids may be listed after it so a token addressed to one of them is never refused). Empty switches the feature off; supply it as Google__ClientIds__0 in the environment.
//Hangfire: Background job processing with PostgreSQL storage. Enabled by default. Dashboard at /hangfire (Admin only).
//PushNotifications: FCM/APNs push notifications. Set Enabled=true and provide credentials to activate. FCM: provide service account JSON path or use ADC. APNs: provide KeyId, TeamId, BundleId, and private key path.
//Alerting: Alerting thresholds for Prometheus/Alertmanager. See PrometheusAlertRules.RulesYaml for alert rules.
//Serilog: MinimumLevel only. The Console sink is configured in code and Serilog composes sinks additively, so a WriteTo array here would log every line twice.
